notes: Golden roster: golden-demon-data.json is the whole Golden persona list; skills and enemies merge the vanilla file with the Golden file, Golden rows winning by name.

Fusion chart: golden-fusion-chart.json is one 23 × 23 grid holding two charts — the upper triangle is the normal two-persona chart and the lower triangle with the diagonal is the triangle (three-persona) chart, as upstream's PersonaFusionChart slices it.

Affinities: all eight upstream axes are kept; Almighty is neutral on every persona and non-neutral only on some shadows. Upstream resist codes carry damage and Light/Dark kill-rate multipliers the app does not model; each collapses to its category (Z → weak; S, T, 2–9 → neutral).

Inheritance: upstream inheritance-types.json gives a weight per inherit type and skill element; weight 0 means the type can never inherit that element. Passive skills have no column and are open to every type. Rank > 89 is never inheritable.
Party personas (golden-party-data.json) are not imported: they are not fusable and their learn-sets are packed Social Link tags.
Shadows: an arcana suffixed " P" upstream marks a boss and imports as boss: true. Enemy ailment strings and resmods are not imported. Enemy skill "Enveration" is read as Enervation.
Skill cards: upstream c[2] names the persona whose Golden skill card carries the skill; it imports as cardPersonaId.
